DeterminationBasis: Existing T03 controls identify actors, authority bases, scope and authority evaluation, but no existing T03 control requires an Authority Object itself to identify the specific subject to whom or to which the authority applies. Actor identity or surrounding authority context is not equivalent to an explicit authority-subject binding. A dedicated subject-identification control is therefore required.

T03-001 includes authority class in its required-evidence list, but its expected behaviour and failure oracle test identifiable valid authority generally and do not require the authority class itself to be explicitly represented or fail when it is absent or ambiguous. No existing T03 expected-behaviour or failure oracle directly tests explicit authority-class identification. A dedicated authority-class explicitness control is therefore required.
